tags.name: Jezero Barbora
tags.qa_note: Re-audited 2026-07-27. Sources disagree on lake area (55-65 ha) and depth (40-70m); 40m is the commonly cited diveable/marked depth. Noted as a range in the markdown rather than picking one figure.

tags.name: Leštinka - Kaňon
tags.qa_note: Now has 3 independent sources. Sources disagree on when mining ceased in this quarry system (geology.cz says 1950s; obeclestinka.cz implies later, closer to end of 20th century) - flagged in markdown as unresolved.

tags.name: Černá Voda - Lom Rampa
tags.qa_note: H. Kulka a spol. / 1918-1919 railway spur history now confirmed by a third independent source (vedazive.cz), in addition to stranypotapecske.cz and tourismato.cz.

tags.name: Slapská Přehrada
tags.qa_note: Re-audited. The reservoir has multiple distinct named dive entry points (e.g. Měřín beach vs. the dam/hráz-náplavka entry) with different wreck features at different depths - not a data conflict, just different sub-sites within the same reservoir.

tags.name: Slezská Harta
tags.qa_note: A claim that the submerged bridge was designed by engineer Rudolf Saliger appeared in one aggregated search result but could not be confirmed on a direct source fetch, so it was NOT added to the markdown.

tags.name: Lom Hostěřadice
tags.qa_note: Fish species list (carp, perch, pike, catfish, crayfish) now independently confirmed by perseus-diving.cz, matching stranypotapecske.cz.

tags.name: Lom Šífr
tags.qa_note: The caisson is named 'Permon' and was the site of a 1967 saturation-diving-style experiment (Vilem Kocian and Vladimir Geist, 100 hours at 25m) confirmed by 2 sources (cs.wikipedia.org, denik.cz). Sources disagree on the month (Wikipedia: November 21-26 1967; aggregated denik.cz result: September 21-26 1967) - flagged as a conflict in the markdown rather than picking one.

tags.name: Orlík - Kostel Technice
tags.qa_note: Re-audited. Depth figures vary by source: stranypotapecske.cz reports roof ~30m/base ~45m with typical dives to 55m; other sources (incl. our original 45-60m) and cs.wikipedia (~40-50m at normal level) are broadly consistent given reservoir level fluctuation. Kept as a range in markdown rather than a single number.

tags.name: Lom Bořená Hora
tags.qa_note: Wreck history deep-researched across 5+ independent sources. Crash facts (28 Oct 2001, near Okrouhla Radoun, Mi-8S/0829, Cernan+Remek+Blaha aboard among 12, no fatalities, 4 injured) are well corroborated. Cause was originally attributed to a fuel float-switch/technician error, but a Prague technician tried for the crash was ACQUITTED by the Pisek district court in Sept 2004 for insufficient evidence - markdown updated to reflect this rather than stating the cause as settled fact. Also corrected: the quarry saw a second, brief period of granite extraction in the 1990s in addition to 1922-1970 (poznatsvet.cz), not previously reflected. Helicopter wreck depth also has a minor conflict: 6-8m (2 sources, used in markdown) vs a single outlying report of ~11m (poznatsvet.cz) - noted.

tags.name: Lom Leštinka
tags.qa_note: Re-audited. Caisson depth reported as 18m by one source (turistika.cz aggregate) vs 20m in our original text - noted as a range. Fish species list has minor variance across sources (roach reported by one source vs bream in our original) - kept species confirmed across sources, flagged the discrepancy rather than silently picking one.

tags.name: Lom Jesenný
tags.qa_note: buddymag.cz is dead (persistent 503) and was dropped as a source, replaced with two working independent sources (vikend.hn.cz, svetcestovatele.cz). Fish species (catfish, carp, pike, perch) now site-specifically confirmed by vikend.hn.cz. Quarry dimensions have a minor conflict: 130x90m (most sources) vs 80x100m (svetcestovatele.cz) - noted in markdown.
